description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waththalpola, Panadura D/S Division, Kaluthara District - Cad. Map No. 530024 (24/0796)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed ownership information, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal status of land titles. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
